title: Digital Marketing Project Proposal
description: A proposal template for digital marketing projects.
intro: Digital Marketing Project Proposal outlines goals, scope, deliverables, and value for a business opportunity.
whenToUse: Use this template when pitching a project or business plan to stakeholders or clients.
template:
Project: [Name]
Client: [Client Name]
Scope: [Scope]
Deliverables: [Deliverables]
Timeline: [Timeline]
Cost: [Cost] 

Benefits: [Why this work matters]

Client: Nova Retail

faqs.question: Should proposals include pricing?
faqs.answer: Yes, include a clear cost estimate and payment expectations.
